tasks.description: Rewrite idea-lab/final_requirements/00_market_research.md from its US/EU framing to Mongolia. READ CLAUDE.md FIRST — its 'Current status' and 'Market facts that change the product thesis' sections are the VERIFIED anchor: account ownership 98.3% (rural 98.8% > urban; NO underbanked gap), borrowing 68.3% (~2x peer; over-credited), saving 47.9% (under-saved), Khan Bank 2.9m customers (82% of population, 99.4% digital, 58-mini-app super-app — 'neobank parity' is NOT a differentiator), SCC sector = 172 cooperatives / 78,608 members / MNT 390bn (the baseline KPI of 100,000 members EXCEEDS the whole sector), regulator FRC (coops) + Bank of Mongolia (banks/e-money), Cyrillic-Mongolian language, MNT currency, Mongolia rails (ACH+/Банксүлжээ/NETC). HONESTY RULE (this is the #1 constraint — market research is where this project has fabricated before and had to retract): state ONLY what CLAUDE.md verifies as fact. Any other quantitative claim, competitor name, market size, or licensee MUST be marked [UNVERIFIED] or written qualitatively — do NOT invent Mongolian competitor names, stats, or figures. A gap marked 'unverified/not researched' is the correct answer; a confident invention is a rejection. REWRITE: (1) Target market — replace 'underserved by banks and neobanks' with the real Mongolia thesis (98.3% banked, over-credited/under-saved, Khan Bank dominance); the honest niche is the digitized SCC cooperative model + governance + savings, NOT neobank-for-the-underbanked. (2) Competitors — replace Alliant/Desjardins/Coop Pank/Monzo/Aspiration with the Mongolia landscape: Khan Bank (CLAUDE.md-verified facts only) and, for others (Golomt/TDB/State Bank/Xac/M Bank, the SCC sector, any e-money), name them ONLY if you can without inventing specifics — otherwise describe the category qualitatively and mark details UNVERIFIED. Keep the cooperative/analogue lens (Desjardins/Coop Pank may stay as INTERNATIONAL cooperative analogues, clearly labelled as such, not local competitors). (3) Differentiators — re-anchor to Mongolia (governance still differentiates; drop any 'neobank parity' claim). (4) Positioning — honest SCC-niche framing. Preserve the header block (update the Status/sourcing note to reflect the Mongolia rewrite + the honesty posture), the section numbering (1-5), and cross-doc consistency (SCC niche, the CLAUDE.md blocking questions — esp. common-bond may bound the addressable market). Currency MNT, Mongolia rails only, no US vendors, no first_name/last_name, no US-insurance framing. Run .softhouse/verify-docs.sh (HARD must be 0; rails/USD/vendor drift must not INCREASE — ideally 00's residual US-rail refs drop). Handoff: section-by-section what changed, every [UNVERIFIED] claim retained, and confirm no fabricated stat/competitor.
